verdict.rationale: Brex documents AI working on account data inside the product. It suggests matching POs and drafts payments, an audit agent ranks potential policy violations by risk level, and AI assistants write memos, offer policy help and categorize spend. Missing for 10: analytical insights such as spend trends, forecasts or savings recommendations are not evidenced; there are no in-depth docs beyond marketing pages; there is no independent or hands-on corroboration.
